description: This file defines an extension to the JNI environment (JNIEnv) for Android, providing utility methods for JNI calls, class and method lookups, string conversions, and exception handling. It facilitates easier and safer JNI interactions within the Starboard Android shared code.

classes.name: JniEnvExt
classes.description: An extension of JNIEnv providing convenience methods for JNI operations, including class/method lookups, string conversions, array creation, and exception handling.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the JniEnvExt instance before starting the application.

methods.name: OnThreadShutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup when a native thread is about to be shut down.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the thread-specific instance of JniEnvExt.

methods.name: GetStarboardBridge
methods.description: Returns the Java object representing the StarboardBridge.

methods.name: FindClassExtOrAbort
methods.description: Finds a Java class by name using the application's class loader, aborting on exception.

methods.name: NewStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Creates a Java String object from a UTF-8 C string, aborting on failure.

methods.name: GetStringStandardUTFOrAbort
methods.description: Converts a Java String to a UTF-8 std::string, aborting on failure.
